'''Rishi corn''' was a type of [[Corn/Legends|corn]] that grew on an inedible cellulose matrix.<ref name="Menu" /> It shared its name with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] served Rishi corn on the inedible cellulose matrix as a [[Foodstuff/Legends|dinner]] side for 3.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] at his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]]<ref name="Menu" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="Atlas"> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] also served [[creamed Rishi corn soup]] for 1.7 credits as its daily [[Soup/Legends|soup]] on [[Zhellday/Legends|Zhelldays]]<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rishi corn was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
